method: Targeted integrated-browser checks at actual desktop/mobile viewport sizes, eight new design/asset tests, updated palette tests, XML parsing and exact scientific-canvas comparison.

checks.observed: Primary actions, map-view selection, destination radios/cards and the stepper use shared orange/sand tokens. Teal branding literals are absent from CSS. White/action contrast is 4.98:1; white/hover contrast is 6.54:1.
The rendered planet disk is 319.14 px at an actual 1206 px viewport and 295.08 px at 980 px, within the proposed 280-360 px range. The image is decoded at its native 512x512 aspect ratio.
Hero copy and the planet scene do not overlap. The three problem cards are below both, rather than covering the illustration.
At actual 390/320 px widths, the visible planet disk is 141.02 px, with a 16 px gap before the copy. Start-button bottoms are 651.92/702.34 px within the 844 px viewport.
A separate mini-Mars remains visible when the intro is hidden and throughout planning, including Save brief. Its mobile image width is 64 px; desktop uses 88 px.

The standalone SVG is valid XML, 5051 bytes, static and free of scripts or external image/font references. Both image URLs use the same content-version key as the release assets; staging includes SVG bytes in that fingerprint.

Decorative scene/mini-Mars images have empty alternatives and are hidden from assistive technology. They add no controls or pointer interception; existing headings, three problem explanations and keyboard actions remain available.
Nominal P retains 61.91699854342489 min margin. Adding 63 observation minutes retains -1.0830014565751185 min and the 20-minute reserve. Original A retains NO_MODELED_ROUTE with null time.
All five nominal-P canvas PNG data-URL SHA-256 values exactly match theme-map-baseline.json. Scientific map/status colors are separate from the new UI action palette.
Keyboard selection of Whole area updates the saved map image to the current canvas. Print body/workspace/brief remain white; decorative mini-Mars is hidden and active animations count is zero.
Document widths remain 375/305 px at actual 390/320 px viewport widths, including expanded activity help and saved briefs. No horizontal overflow or overlapping hero copy was observed.
125 unit tests, five actual-data integration checks and 32 static-delivery checks pass. The unchanged model/data guards remain required; the upload now includes the one reusable decorative SVG.

boundaries: The Mars illustration is decorative artwork, not calibrated imagery, a terrain map or a modeled route.
Representative contrast and keyboard/pointer checks are not a full accessibility audit or a human usability study.
Mobile viewport checks do not claim a physical touch-device test.
Historical theme/browser records retain their original release scope; actual hosting and native print/save dialogs remain separate acceptance checks.
